title: authentication
content:
# Authentication

GitScope supports multiple authentication methods.

Users can register using email and password.

Email verification is performed using OTP.

Users can also sign in using GitHub OAuth.

JWT authentication is used for securing APIs.

Authentication tokens are stored securely using HTTP cookies.

title: dashboard
content:
# Dashboard

The dashboard stores repository analyses.

Users can:

- View previous analyses
- Revisit reports
- Open analyzed repositories again

title: explore
content:
# Explore

The Explore page lists trending GitHub repositories.

Users can:

- Browse repositories
- View stars
- Open repository links
- Analyze any repository directly

This helps users discover interesting open-source projects.

title: faq
content:
Can I analyze private repositories?

No. GitScope currently supports only public GitHub repositories.

---

Can I analyze any GitHub issue?

Yes.

---

Do I need a GitHub account?

No.

---

Can I save analyses?

Yes. Previous analyses appear in your dashboard.

title: issue-analysis
content:
# Issue Analysis

Users can analyze GitHub issues.

For every issue GitScope explains:

- What the issue means
- Difficulty
- Files likely to change
- Skills required
- Step-by-step approach
- Possible implementation idea

This helps developers decide whether they should work on an issue.

title: overview
content:
# GitScope

GitScope is an AI-powered platform that helps developers understand GitHub repositories and contribute to open-source projects.

Users can analyze repositories, understand project architecture, analyze GitHub issues, discover beginner-friendly issues, and receive AI-generated contribution guidance.

Main features:

- Repository Analysis
- Issue Analysis
- Explore Trending Repositories
- Good First Issues
- Search GitHub Issues
- Dashboard with Analysis History
- GitHub OAuth Login
- Email OTP Authentication
- Redis Caching

title: repository-analysis
content:
# Repository Analysis

Users can paste a public GitHub repository URL.

GitScope analyzes the repository and provides:

- Repository summary
- Main purpose
- Difficulty level
- Folder structure explanation
- Important files
- Contribution roadmap
- Skills required
- Recommended starting point

The analysis helps developers understand unfamiliar repositories faster.
